title: Unit-normalized strict tower comparison for integral coefficient presentations
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme W, scalar restriction from the ordinary completed integral coefficients to the actual adic completion carries its complete strict reduction tower naturally isomorphically to the ordinary finite quotient tower followed by scalar restriction. At every degree and finite quotient level this isomorphism sends the actual completed quotient unit to the scalar restriction of the ordinary quotient augmentation. This holds for every unbounded cochain complex without flatness or completeness hypotheses.

proof.text: For the same-site coefficient comparison, lift the canonical completed ring comparison to commutative ring sheaves and use its prescribed finite projections. The corresponding square of scalar restrictions is invertible. The generic square_iso theorem, applied to the ordinary scalar-extension adjunctions and the two restriction equivalences, gives a finite-level comparison preserving the actual tensor units. Apply it degreewise. Quotient units are epimorphisms; isoOfEpiAugmentations therefore assembles the level comparisons into a natural isomorphism of entire augmented strict towers, on all cochain complexes. No flatness or completeness condition is used.

proof_origin.place: Q7: invertible ordinary scalar-restriction adjunction square and epimorphic quotient-unit assembly.

theorem integralCoefficientStrictTowerComparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (W : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ c : pbcIntegralTransportComplex W l E ⋙
        completedReductionComplexTowerFunctor W (pbcIntegralDatum l E) ⋙
          HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex ≅
      IntegralOnSlice.tower l E W none ⋙
        (Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ _ _).obj (pbcIntegralTransportComplex W l E),
      ∀ (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ),
        ((completedReductionModuleUnit (pbcIntegralDatum l E) W).app
            ((pbcIntegralTransportModules W l E).obj (P.X i))).app (op n) ≫
            ((c.hom.app P).app (op n)).f i =
          (pbcIntegralTransportModules W l E).map
            ((((IntegralOnSlice.augmentation l E W none).app P).app (op n)).f i)
